title: Take a Step Back: A Dual-Granularity Raw Feature Empowered Intermediate Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although multimodal recommendations have shown the ability to learn user preferences and item properties by leveraging explicit multimodal information, they remain constrained by two critical limitations: low-quality representation learning and modality fusion. For the former, existing solutions primarily focus on multi-granularity representation learning; however, we argue that training such representations is difficult due to the inherent data sparsity problem in recommendation scenarios. For the latter, existing solutions often rely on contrastive learning to align representations of different modalities to facilitate modality fusion, yet alignment-only objectives may over-compress valuable modality-specific information. To this end, we suggest \underline{``Take a Step Back"} and propose a \textbf{D}ual-granularity raw feature empowered \textbf{I}ntermediate fusion \textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}onvolutional \textbf{N}etwork (\textbf{DIGCN}

translated_title: 退一步思考：一种双粒度原始特征赋能的中间融合图卷积网络用于多模态推荐
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态推荐已经展现出通过利用显式多模态信息来学习用户偏好和物品属性的能力，但它们仍然受到两个关键限制的制约：低质量的表示学习和模态融合。针对前者，现有的解决方案主要聚焦于多粒度表示学习；然而，我们认为，由于推荐场景中固有的数据稀疏性问题，训练此类表示是困难的。针对后者，现有的解决方案通常依赖对比学习来对齐不同模态的表示以促进模态融合，但仅对齐的目标可能会过度压缩有价值的模态特有信息。为此，我们建议“退一步思考”，提出了一种双粒度原始特征赋能的中间融合图卷积网络（DIGCN）
tldr: 提出DIGCN，通过“退一步”利用双粒度原始特征赋能的中间融合图卷积网络，同时解决多模态推荐中低质量表示学习和模态过度对齐压缩两大问题。
en_tdlr: DIGCN, a dual-granularity raw feature empowered intermediate fusion graph convolutional network, addresses both low-quality representation learning and over-compressed modality-specific information in multimodal recommendation by "taking a step back" to leverage raw features.
